name: Suction bucket / suction caisson jacket foundations
description: Open-bottomed inverted-bucket foundation embedded by pumping water out (negative pressure); resists lateral and axial loads and is removable by reverse pumping.

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Suction caisson: statistics from 2002 showed 485 suction caissons installed in more than 50 localities, in depths to about 2,000 m
Wikipedia Suction caisson: 12 caissons at Gorm (1981, 40 m depth); Diana caissons 30 m high, 6.5 m diameter, installed ~1,500 m on soft clay (1999)

specifications.metric: Snorre A suction anchor length vs conventional pile
specifications.basis: Wikipedia Suction caisson: analysis showed safe fixity with 12 m suction caissons vs up to 90 m piles where pebbles at 60 m depth prevented piling; production started 1992
Wikipedia Suction caisson, Gravity oil platforms: Troll A founded in 330 m depth with 30 m long skirts; Gullfaks C 22 m skirts

applications: Open-bottomed inverted-bucket foundation embedded by pumping water out (negative pressure); resists lateral and axial loads and is removable by reverse pumping.
